description: Puts out white noise on as many polyphonic channels as the cable patched into it carries

inputs.text: Only the number of polyphonic channels is read here, not the signal itself; with nothing patched, one channel of noise comes out

outputs.text: White noise between -5V and 5V, a separate stream on every channel

notes: shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
